intro: Seemandham and valaikappu are among the most loved family functions in Tamil Nadu. Custom calls for several kinds of mixed rice, called kalandha sadham, along with sweets, and many families also serve a full banana-leaf lunch.
We prepare the traditional varieties the way families expect, keep the spice gentle for the mother-to-be, and pack portions for her to take home.
includes: Five or seven kinds of kalandha sadham, as per your custom
Sakkarai pongal, payasam and traditional sweets

faqs: How many kinds of rice are served at a valaikappu?
Many families serve five or seven kinds, as per their custom. Tell us yours and we will prepare them.
Can you cater a seemandham function at home?
Yes. We cater seemandham functions at homes, temple mandapams and halls around Vellore.
Can the food be made without onion and garlic?
Yes. Tell us when you book and we will prepare the full menu without onion and garlic.
